policies.title: Portuguese ordinary passports: Panama visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Panama's current Foreign Ministry treaty register records the bilateral suppression of visas for common passports with Portugal.
conditions: This evidence establishes the ordinary/common-passport visa-waiver baseline only; it does not establish work, residence, length of stay, carrier, health or final-admission conditions.
The result follows Panama's named Portugal common-passport agreement, not an inferred regional or reciprocal complement.

policies.title: Portuguese ordinary passports: Bangladesh arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Bangladesh's Lisbon Embassy expressly makes Portuguese passport holders eligible for a single-entry tourism visa on arrival.
conditions: The stated route is single entry, up to 30 days, at the Bangladesh port of entry for tourism, subject to the immigration officer's satisfaction.
Carry the stated supporting documents, return ticket and required funds. Work, residence, special passports, carrier conditions and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Portuguese ordinary passports: Jordan arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Jordan's official Tourism Board lists Portugal as eligible for a visa obtained on arrival.
conditions: The named Portugal entry gives an arrival visa at the stated 40 JOD fee. It does not establish an eVisa requirement merely because Jordan separately offers electronic services.
Entry-point, passport-validity, return/onward travel, work, residence, special-passport and final-admission conditions remain separate.
